name: The Westin Reserva Conchal
insider_take: This beachfront sanctuary sits on Costa Rica's most stunning white-sand beach, where the Pacific meets pristine rainforest in the exclusive Peninsula Papagayo.
whats_special: Playa Conchal is famous for being made entirely of crushed seashells, creating naturally sparkling white sand that stays cool underfoot. The hotel sits within a 2,300-acre nature preserve home to over 150 bird species, three-toed sloths, and howler monkeys. The championship Robert Trent Jones Jr. golf course winds through native dry forest with ocean views from 15 holes.
pro_tip: Book the sunset horseback ride along Playa Conchal - the shell beach creates a magical glittering effect during golden hour that's absolutely Instagram-worthy.
dont_miss: The hotel's sea turtle nesting program runs July through December, offering guided nighttime tours to witness Olive Ridley turtles laying eggs. Visit the nearby fishing village of Brasilito for authentic Costa Rican sodas (local restaurants) just a 10-minute walk down the beach.
pros: All-inclusive luxury resort with premium dining, drinks, and activities included for a seamless Costa Rica escape
World-class Robert Trent Jones II championship golf course set amid stunning tropical landscapes
Pristine Playa Conchal beachfront access, one of Costa Rica's most beautiful and secluded white-sand beaches
Expansive family-friendly water park and multiple pools offering exceptional recreation for all ages
Heavenly Spa by Westin delivering world-renowned wellness treatments amid a serene natural rainforest setting
cons: Secluded resort location requires planned transportation for excursions beyond the property
Large-scale resort property may feel expansive for guests preferring a more intimate boutique experience
